data.name: Pivot_Name

data.name: Unpivot_Name
data.value: UNPIVOT

data.name: Unpivot_Alternative
data.value: Build the rows with UNION ALL over the individual columns.

data.name: Merge_Name
data.value: MERGE

data.value: Use separate INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE statements.

data.name: TryCatch_Name

data.value: Error handling is not available yet. Run the statements one at a time and check the error message.

data.name: While_Name
data.value: WHILE loops

data.name: While_Alternative
data.value: Solve the task with set-based operations or a recursive CTE.

data.name: ControlFlow_Name
data.value: Flow control (IF, BEGIN ... END, GOTO, RETURN, WAITFOR)

data.name: ControlFlow_Alternative
data.value: Use a CASE expression inside the query and run the statements one at a time.

data.name: PrintRaiseError_Name
data.value: PRINT, RAISERROR and THROW

data.value: Return values with a SELECT statement.

data.name: Cursor_Name
data.value: Cursors

data.name: Cursor_Alternative
data.value: Solve the task with set-based operations, using window functions if needed.

data.name: TableVariable_Name

data.value: Use a temporary table (CREATE TABLE #t), which is available in this environment.

data.name: SelectAssignment_Name
data.value: Variable assignment with SELECT (SELECT @x = ...)

data.name: SelectAssignment_Alternative
data.value: Assign the value with SET @x = (SELECT ...).

data.name: StoredProcedure_Name
data.value: Stored procedures

data.name: StoredProcedure_Alternative
data.value: Run the statements of the procedure directly as a script.

data.name: UserDefinedFunction_Name
data.value: User-defined functions

data.name: UserDefinedFunction_Alternative
data.value: Write the expression directly in the query or use a view.

data.name: UserDefinedFunctionCall_Name
data.value: Calls to user-defined functions

data.name: UserDefinedFunctionCall_Alternative
data.value: Write the expression directly in the query.

data.name: Trigger_Name
data.value: Triggers

data.name: Trigger_Alternative
data.value: Run the statements of the trigger yourself after the change.

data.name: Execute_Name
data.value: EXEC and EXECUTE

data.name: Execute_Alternative
data.value: Write the statement directly in the script.

data.name: OutputClause_Name

data.name: OutputClause_Alternative

data.name: ForClause_Name
data.value: FOR XML and FOR JSON

data.value: Return the result as a regular table.

data.name: TableValuedFunction_Name
data.value: Table-valued functions (STRING_SPLIT, OPENJSON, OPENXML, OPENROWSET ...)

data.name: TableValuedFunction_Alternative
data.value: Generate the rows with VALUES, UNION ALL or a recursive CTE.

data.name: JsonFunction_Name
data.value: JSON functions (JSON_VALUE, JSON_QUERY, JSON_MODIFY, ISJSON)

data.name: JsonFunction_Alternative
data.value: Store the values in separate columns and query them directly.

data.value: TRY_CAST, TRY_CONVERT, TRY_PARSE and PARSE

data.value: Use CAST or CONVERT and check the values beforehand with a CASE expression.

data.value: CONVERT with this style code

data.value: Use one of the supported style codes ({0}) or the FORMAT function.

data.name: UserDefinedType_Name
data.value: User-defined and XML data types

data.name: UserDefinedType_Alternative
data.value: Use one of the standard data types.

data.value: Use IDENTITY only on an integer column with an inline PRIMARY KEY, for example Id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY.

data.value: Recreate the table without the constraint and copy the data.

data.value: Create the view without options.

data.name: DropMultipleTables_Name

data.name: DropMultipleTables_Alternative
data.value: Drop each table with its own DROP TABLE statement.

data.value: Remove the table hint. This environment does not use hints.

data.value: Build the subtotals with several GROUP BY queries and UNION ALL.

data.name: AnyAll_Name
data.value: ANY, ALL and SOME with a subquery
